title: Fire taught the difference between backup and replica
body: When OVHcloud's Strasbourg datacenter burned in 2021, customers whose only copies lived in the same building lost data permanently, while replicated and off-site backups survived. Replication mirrors corruption and deletion faithfully; only separated, versioned copies forgive. Geography is a backup feature, not a deployment detail, a distinction the incident priced in euros.
source_hint: OVHcloud fire reports and customer postmortems (2021)
